status: Implemented and bounded checks passed; live integrations, physical Pencil and distribution gates remain.
changes: Retained EPUB/PDF ink drafts keep captured source context, original native bytes and stable retry identity across source-view teardown and persistence failure; explicit unplaced recovery is available when reliable placement cannot be obtained.
Delayed reader messages are rejected when captured book/pass/edition/asset/resource context is no longer current.

Compact panes retain their hosted view state. Hidden notebooks release only their own TextKit/Pencil responder; unfinished composition is captured before stale snapshots, and fresh hidden Pencil canvases cannot save an unintended erasure.
Reader font size persists, chapter and markup mode survive pane switching, and cancelling the attachment picker is not an error.

Experimental US-only explicit Kindle web sign-in/catalog import uses an isolated ephemeral WebKit session and complete bounded pagination; cancellation/malformed or incomplete responses do not partially import. Live Amazon compatibility remains unqualified.
The typed WASM SDK now exposes catalog/social recommendations and approved encrypted-sync preparation/seal/open with native parity; caller hosts retain atomic replay/outbox responsibilities.

headless_reader_acceptance.scope: Actual SQLite failure/retry/reopen/export, retained source-session and callback guards, and real headless WKWebView layout anchoring on the receipt’s preserved earlier Swift inputs. Final compact host/visibility adjustments were subsequently covered by native focus regression, device test33 and all three app builds.

native_focus_regression.scope: Actual hidden-window AppKit IME/latest-text preservation, stale-snapshot and queued-format guards, unrelated responder protection; negative control failed as expected. iOS branch typechecked. Its NotebookView input predates the final retained host wrapper; that exact version is preserved.

kindle_acceptance.scope: Synthetic parser/paging, native atomic import, actual headless WebKit isolation/deadline/cancellation; no Amazon account sign-in or live catalog response.

sdk_and_rust.sdk_scope: Actual extracted Rust crates, installed npm CJS/ESM/Node/browser WASM and strict types, extracted Swift SDK; current staged archives match final build provenance. Native/WASM recommendation and encrypted-sync parity passed. No external publication occurred.

limitations: No physical Apple Pencil was available: pressure/contact/palm rejection, hardware stroke capture and stroke alignment under reflow/rotation remain unqualified.

Automatic approval review rejected the requested copy of the QA application store; it was not retried. No fresh device database/export inspection was performed. Current persistence evidence is UI reopen, not a byte-level database comparison.
The earlier historical exact ink/transcription store evidence remains historical and does not verify this final run.
No live Amazon/Audible/Castalia account, issuer authorization, social publication, distribution signing or deployment was qualified.
Process-memory pending reader captures survive view teardown and failed saves while the app stays open; this is not forced-termination durability for uncommitted ink.

The current native provider composition still has integration-specific paths; declared catalog/content/position/social/identity/authority ports and reusable native Castalia secure custody/consent composition are not all delivered as public interchangeable host components.
No complete-release readiness claim: live provider/issuer qualification, physical Pencil and distribution/deployment require their explicit external prerequisites.
evidence_scope: Historical reader-context baseline before provider/custody extraction. Exact original evidence and delivered artifacts are preserved; no new physical-device claim.
